rules.title: OnPush or signals for change detection
rules.what: Use ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush or signal-based components, with immutable inputs and trackBy/track on lists.
rules.why: With default detection, every binding of every component is re-evaluated after any event: thousands of checks for a keystroke on a large page.
rules.how: changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush; signals for local state; @for (x of items; track x.id).

patterns.note: Component without OnPush or signals in this file.

verify.how: Angular DevTools profiler shows change-detection cycles limited to the affected components.

limits: Default detection is a reasonable choice on a small, rarely updated component.

rules.title: No method calls in templates
rules.what: Bind templates to precomputed values, signals or pure pipes, not to component method calls.
rules.why: A method in a binding runs at every change-detection pass, far more often than its result changes.
rules.how: Compute once in the component or a computed() signal; @Pipe({ pure: true }) for formatting.

patterns.note: Method call in an interpolation; signals (name()) are fine.

verify.how: Template bindings reference fields, signals or pure pipes.

rules.title: Tear down subscriptions
rules.what: Use the async pipe or takeUntilDestroyed for subscriptions; every manual subscribe has a teardown.
rules.why: A subscription that outlives its component keeps the component and everything it captures alive; navigating back and forth leaks one copy per visit.

patterns.note: Manual subscription; files with takeUntil, the async pipe or unsubscribe stay silent.

verify.how: Component destroy test asserts no active subscription remains.

rules.title: Lazy routes, lean production bundle
rules.what: Lazy-load feature routes and remove unused polyfills, modules and locale data from production builds.
rules.why: Eager modules and blanket polyfills ship code most visitors never run.
rules.how: loadComponent/loadChildren in routes; budgets in angular.json; only the locales you serve.

verify.how: Production build budgets pass; per-route chunks visible in the stats.
